note: Categories are based on annual changes: +2.81% (strong increase); between +1.16% and +2.81% (moderate increase), between -1.14% and +1.16% (little change); between -2.73% and -1.14% (moderate decrease); and less than -2.73% (strong decrease).
title: Share of populations increasing, stable or declining in the Living Planet Index
subtitle: The Living Planet Index (LPI) measures the change in 35,803 wildlife populations. This chart shows the share of populations in taxonomic groups that have been increasing, stable, or declining.
sourceDesc: Marconi et al. (2026). A deep dive into the Living Planet Index 2026 – A technical report.
